description: This file defines a controller class in PHP for managing store JSON files within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically focusing on generating and clearing store configuration files.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class for managing store JSON files in the admin panel of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates JSON files containing store information for each language set in the store configuration.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes generated JSON store files for each language.
